question: Should this PR remain blocked until redacted live Signal/gateway proof is added, or may maintainers accept the current mocked handler test evidence while choosing it as the canonical Signal retry fix?
rationale: The implementation shape is source-supported, but this external PR changes a live message-delivery path and there are multiple open candidates for the same issue.

options.title: Require Live Signal Proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted Signal/gateway logs, terminal output, or an artifact shows an actual conflicted follow-up DM being retried or preserved.

options.title: Accept Synthetic Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the focused mocked regression evidence, but that would merge a Signal delivery change without live channel proof.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: If another open Signal retry PR is preferred, pause this branch and close it only after the replacement merges or becomes clearly canonical.

recommendation.title: Require Live Signal Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted Signal/gateway logs, terminal output, or an artifact shows an actual conflicted follow-up DM being retried or preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged the closest sibling Slack retry fix and has the strongest routing signal for choosing among duplicate channel retry PRs.
